headline: St. Olaf carries an unbeaten record into December
dek: St. Olaf has won 21 matches and drawn four without a defeat, scoring 59 goals while conceding sixteen across the season. A road victory at Tufts kept the run alive, leaving St. Olaf as the lone MIAC program still playing as the schedule turns to Amherst.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring across the MIAC concentrates sharply at the top: Saint John's (Minn.) alone produced 75 goals, more than St. Scholastica, Hamline, Saint Mary's (Minn.), and Concordia-Moorhead combined.

wire.line: MIAC programs posted 39 wins, fifteen draws, and 30 losses outside the conference, scoring 175 goals and conceding 118.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four early-season matches have passed their scheduled dates without a published result: Bethel against Saint Cloud State and Minnesota, St. Olaf against Wisconsin-Eau Claire, and Gustavus against Nebraska Wesleyan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: St. Olaf forward Jack Soares has scored thirteen goals on 44 shots, the highest goal total among the conference's published leaders.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Mary's (Minn.) goalkeeper Bode Jacobsen has faced heavy volume all season, making 74 saves while conceding 34 goals for a 0.685 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint John's (Minn.) finished with seventeen wins, three draws, and three losses while conceding fourteen goals.

last_match.line: St. Olaf extended its unbeaten season with a road victory to keep the MIAC's postseason run alive.

next_match.line: St. Olaf enters unbeaten all season and has won every match since its draw against Saint John's (Minn.).

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
